hooks.name: player_bundle_item_select
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's PlayerBundleItemSelect)

rust_summary: A server player selected an item in a bundle (`native_player_bundle_item_select`).
doc_summary: A server player selected the item at `index` in a bundle in menu `slot`: `native_player_bundle_item_select(player, name, slot, index)`. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_bundle_item_select@.
